growth_rep_note: v1.6. Gunaratna 2010: 9 small studies, 2 peer-reviewed; Donato 2020 cluster RCT null (consumption package). Sheet Median implies HAZ +0.08-0.22, above SQ-LNS +0.14 (Dewey 2021)
pen_note: v1.6. Sheet assumes every CG-derived variety carries every edit. Opaque2-type traits: soft endosperm, ear rot, yield drag; strong lpa alleles hurt germination; high-zinc wheat no penalty
fib_note: v1.6. Threapleton 2013 is a cohort meta-analysis
base_growth_note: v1.6. CGIAR: every new variety to meet minimum nutrient standards within a decade (Nov 2025); India: no rice release below 20 ppm Zn; most CIMMYT elite wheat lines carry extra zinc
cf_note: v1.6. Credited = DALYs - prob x DALYs of the same rollout delayed. Others: IRRI OsNAS2 edit, rice LKR knockout, maize zein edits, CGIAR low-phytate plans; no one else found mainstreaming nutrient edits into CG pipelines
cost_gate_note: v1.6. If every crop fails, the program stops; later costs x P(any crop works)
bar_note: GiveWell: 'As of May 2026, our bar for funding programs is 6x our benchmark' (8x Nov 2025)
gd_note: GiveWell legacy cash benchmark (~$300 per doubling of consumption for a person-year); new benchmark said to be similar
